decision.reasoning_trace: I am looking for a functional, high-quality hiking backpack. I selected a range of options: a premium ultralight pack (Granite Gear), a budget packable option (ZOMAKE), a hydration-focused pack (Mubasel Gear), a tactical high-capacity pack (G4Free), and a mid-range technical hiking pack (KAILAS). After reviewing the feedback, the KAILAS 28L stands out as a high-value choice; several reviews compare its quality to high-end Osprey packs and praise its internal frame ventilation system. At $69.99, it offers the best balance of specialized hiking features and durability compared to the lighter but more fragile packable options or the purely tactical style of the G4Free.
